app.tagline: The security boundary is wired. Build your app inside it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHelp: Choose how the app looks. System follows your operating system.

language.title: Language
language.help: Choose the interface language. System follows your operating system.

proxyMode.label: Proxy mode
proxyMode.help: Off (default): same-format bindings connect directly; usage isn’t counted. On: routed through AiOpt’s proxy; usage is counted.

warnOnQuitWithProxy.label: Warn before quitting with proxy active
warnOnQuitWithProxy.help: On (default): if agents are routed through AiOpt’s proxy, confirm before quitting — they can’t connect until AiOpt runs again. Off: quit without asking.

promptCache.label: Prompt cache for Anthropic providers
promptCache.help: On (default): requests proxied to an Anthropic-format provider get cache breakpoints when the client sent none, so repeated context is billed at the cached rate. Off: requests are forwarded as sent.

experimentalMode.label: Experimental mode
experimentalMode.help: Off (default): hides in-progress features such as Workbench. On: shows experimental tabs and tray entries.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutHelp: Sign in to connect this device. The local stub accepts any username and password.
account.error: Sign-in failed. Check your details and try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.recording: Press the new shortcut… (Esc to cancel)

check-for-updates.label: Check for Updates

toggle-theme.label: Toggle Light / Dark
toggle-theme.description: Switch between the light and dark appearance.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Add a provider once, then point each agent at the provider and model it should use.

agents.heading: Agents
agents.waitingForProvider: Add a provider first — then bind each detected agent here.
agents.emptyInstalled: No agents detected on this machine yet. Install a supported CLI or show not-detected agents below.

setup.title: Get started
setup.step1Hint: Enter API details yourself, or import a subscription login already on this computer.
setup.step2Hint: Pick which agent should use your provider pool and model.
setup.step2Waiting: Complete step 1 first, then bind agents from the list below.
setup.noAgentsHint: Install and sign in to a supported agent CLI (Codex, Claude Code, Copilot, …). You can still add providers now and bind later.

combined.name: Combined provider
combined.description: Every model from your pool in one list — pick it when binding an agent.
combined.helpTooltip: The combined provider merges every pool entry into one model list for binding. It is virtual — not an editable card in the provider pool.
combined.settingsDisabled: Add at least one provider to enable it.

pool.heading: Provider pool
pool.empty: No providers yet. Add one to get started.

errors.restartRequired: Quit and reopen the app, then scan again.

form.presetCustomHint: Custom setup — pick API key or Custom OAuth below.
form.presetApiHint: API key vendor — paste your key below.
form.presetOAuthHint: Subscription preset — after saving, use Connect on the provider card.
form.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored key
form.aliasHint: Alias: a shorter or agent-consistent name written to the agent instead of the model ID (e.g. a long id shortened, or a gateway's custom name). Falls back to the model ID when blank.
form.loadModelsFromCatalog: Vendor had no model list — filled from models.dev catalog.
form.modelsDevStale: models.dev cache is stale — refresh catalog for newer names.
form.apiFormatsHint: Tick every format this endpoint serves. A binding uses the one the agent speaks natively when it can.
form.detectNone: No supported format answered at this URL. Check the Base URL (and key), or tick the formats by hand.
form.keySavedHidden: A key is saved · hidden for security. Leave blank to keep it, or type to replace.
form.credentialModeLocked: Authentication type cannot be changed after the provider is created.
form.oauthHint: After saving, use Connect on the provider card to sign in. Tokens stay in the app — they are never written to agent config.
form.oauthStubHint: Built-in ChatGPT / Claude / Copilot sign-in is coming in a gated release. For now use an API key preset or Custom OAuth for your own IdP.
form.dropHint: Some upstreams reject a request carrying a parameter they don't recognize instead of ignoring it — a gateway in front of a strict backend is the usual cause. Pick the parameters to strip before AiOpt forwards a request to this provider.

dropGroupHint.safe: Bookkeeping and routing hints. Removing these doesn't change the model's reply.
dropGroupHint.sensitive: Removing these changes what comes back: without response_format, guaranteed JSON becomes free text; without thinking or reasoning, the model is quietly downgraded. Use only when the upstream rejects them outright.

profiles.heading: Binding profiles
profiles.hint: Save every agent's current binding under a name and switch the whole setup in one step.
profiles.mcpDeclined: Profile not applied: the MCP server write was cancelled.
profiles.mcpSkipped: Applied. {{count}} MCP servers in this profile were skipped (removed, or not supported by that agent).

card.agentImportHint: Session read from the agent on each request

testErrors.no_models: Add at least one model first.

agent.drift: Config on disk no longer matches this binding.

configView.title: Config

modes.exclusive: Exclusive — the active provider is overwritten
modes.additive: Additive — providers coexist, only the default moves

configView.noFiles: This agent has no config files AiOpt manages.
configView.rawHint: AiOpt shows what it manages, never the file contents — some of these files hold an API key in plain text. Open one to read it in your own editor.

binding.title: Choose provider
binding.help: Pick a provider and model, then Apply.
binding.viaProxyHint: This provider's format differs from what this agent speaks. AiOpt translates it through the local proxy, so the agent only connects while AiOpt is running.
binding.unsupportedHint: AiOpt can't translate between this provider's format and this agent.
binding.modelHint: Model (optional — defaults to the first, change anytime)
binding.selectProviderHint: Select a provider on the left to see its models.

errors.INVALID_PARAMS: Some details are invalid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That provider or model no longer exists.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: A provider with that id already exists.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Secrets can't be stored on this system right now. Check that OS encryption is available and try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This agent can't be configured yet.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The provider rejected the API key. Check the key and try again.
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: Couldn't load models from the provider. Check the Base URL and try again.

usage.title: Usage
usage.empty: No usage recorded yet. Only requests that go through AiOpt's proxy appear here. Turn on Proxy mode in Settings, bind an agent, and send a request—or use a binding that routes through AiOpt. Some bindings (including Gemini) stay direct and won't show up.

source.label: Usage source
source.proxyHint: Requests that went through AiOpt's proxy.
source.localHint: Read from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and pi session logs on this computer. Includes direct bindings. Cursor keeps no token counts, so its usage is estimated from the conversation text.

local.failed: Couldn't read the agent session logs.
local.empty: No usage found in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or pi session logs.

weekday.title: By weekday
weekday.hint: Average tokens per day of the week

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.intro: One library of MCP servers, kept in sync with each agent's own MCP config. Editing the library never changes an agent; push writes it, and AiOpt asks you to confirm the exact command or URL first.
mcp.empty: No MCP servers yet — none in the library, none in any agent config. Add one to start.
mcp.declined: Not written — you cancelled the confirmation.
mcp.secretsUnavailable: OS secret encryption is unavailable, so environment variable and header values cannot be saved.
mcp.unreadable: {{agent}}'s MCP config ({{path}}) could not be read. AiOpt will not write it until it is fixed.
mcp.claudeNote: Claude Code rewrites ~/.claude.json often. Quit Claude Code before changing its servers so your change is not overwritten.

detail.notInLibrary: Not in the library yet. Pull it from an agent to manage it here.
detail.cannotPush: This agent cannot take this server: its transport (SSE) or its name is not supported there.

confirm.pushAll: Write the library's copy of this server into every agent that can take it, overwriting theirs?
confirm.delete: Delete this server from the library? Agent configs keep their copies.
confirm.deleteAgent: Remove this server from this agent's config? The library and other agents keep theirs.
confirm.deleteAgentLast: This is the only copy of this server — the library and every other agent lack it. Removing it cannot be undone. Remove anyway?
confirm.overwriteAgent: Overwrite the agent's copy with the library's?
confirm.overwriteLibrary: Overwrite the library's copy with the agent's, including its values?
confirm.merge: Take the picked agent fields into the library? The agent's config is not changed.

diff.title: Changes
diff.mergeHint: Fields set to “Use agent” are taken into the library; the rest keep the library's. Values are compared but never shown.

form.name: Name
form.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, “-”, “_” or “.” (up to 64), starting with a letter or number.
form.nameTaken: A server with this name already exists.
form.valuesNote: Values are stored encrypted in AiOpt and written into the agent's config file in plain text, which the agent needs.
form.libraryNote: Saving changes the library only. Push the server to an agent to write it there.

errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: A server with this name already exists.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That server no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: An agent's MCP config could not be read, or secret encryption is unavailable.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: That agent does not support this transport.
errors.INTERNAL: Could not write the agent's MCP config.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Past Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and pi sessions, read from the logs they keep on this computer. AiOpt only reads these files.
sessions.failed: Couldn't read the agent session logs.
sessions.empty: No Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or pi sessions found.
sessions.truncated: Only the most recent sessions are shown.
sessions.newTaskHint: Open a workbench task that references this session; its recent messages go to the agent as background when the task starts.
sessions.transcriptTruncated: This session is long; only the most recent messages are shown.

pack.title: Context pack
pack.hint: Click a message to pick it; Shift-click picks a range. The pack is Markdown to start a new session with.
pack.copied: Copied a context pack of {{count}} messages.
pack.exported: Exported a context pack of {{count}} messages.
pack.cut: Older picks were left out to keep it short.
pack.stale: The session changed since it was opened. Go back and open it again.

skills.title: Skills
skills.emptyHint: Import a skill folder, or pull one an agent already has into the library.

confirm.pushAll: Overwrite this skill in every agent with the library copy?
confirm.delete: Delete this skill from the central library? Agent copies are left untouched.
confirm.deleteAgent: Delete this agent's copy of the skill? The library and other agents' copies are left untouched.
confirm.deleteAgentLast: This is the only copy of this skill — the library and every other agent are without it. Deleting it can't be undone. Delete anyway?
confirm.overwriteAgent: Overwrite the agent's copy with the library copy?
confirm.overwriteLibrary: Overwrite the library copy with the agent's copy?
confirm.merge: Apply the picked agent files to the library copy? The agent's copy is left untouched.

diff.title: Changes
diff.mergeHint: Files set to “Use agent” are written to the library; the rest keep the library version.

errors.importMissingMarker: This folder is not a skill — put SKILL.md in the folder you select (not a parent folder that only contains subfolders).
errors.importParentFolder: You selected a parent folder. Open the skill folder itself — the one that contains SKILL.md at its root — then import again.
errors.importInvalidFolderName: The folder name can't be used as a skill name (don't start with “.”, and don't use “/” or “\”). Rename the folder and try again.
errors.importSourceNotDirectory: That path isn't a folder. Select the skill directory (the folder that contains SKILL.md).
errors.importSourceUnreachable: That folder couldn't be read (it may have been moved or deleted). Pick the skill folder again.
errors.importSymlinkInTree: This skill contains a symbolic link. Remove symlinks from the skill folder, or copy the skill without them, then import again. (Version-control folders like .git are skipped automatically.)
errors.importUnsupportedFileType: This skill contains a special file (not a regular file). Remove sockets, devices, or similar entries and try again.
errors.importTooManyFiles: This skill has too many files to import. Remove unneeded files and try again.
errors.importTooLarge: This skill is too large to import. Remove or shrink large files and try again.
errors.importDestinationFailed: Couldn't write the skill into the library folder. Check that AiOpt can access its data folder and try again.
errors.INVALID_PARAMS: Some details are invalid. Try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: That action isn't permitted, or the skill contains files that can't be synced safely.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: That skill can't be synced right now.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This agent has no known skills directory.

workbench.title: Workbench
workbench.subtitle: Chat with a coordinator that breaks work into tasks, then run each approved task as its own pi agent in a herdr session. Uses pi's provider and model from Providers.
workbench.stopConfirm: Stop the workbench? Every running task is stopped too.
workbench.removeConfirm: Remove this task and its worktree? The branch is kept. A worktree with uncommitted changes isn't removed.
workbench.herdrMissing: herdr wasn't found, so tasks can't run. Chat still works. Install herdr below or restart after installing elsewhere.
workbench.attachHint: Watch or take over the agents from a terminal:

herdr.notFound: herdr wasn't found. If you installed it already, make sure it's on your PATH—or install it below with AiOpt.
herdr.sshHint: Runs herdr on that machine over SSH (not herdr's TUI --remote attach).

issue.unsupported_platform: The workbench isn't available on Windows yet.
issue.pi_missing: pi wasn't found. Install the pi CLI, then try again.
issue.herdr_missing: herdr wasn't found. Install herdr, then try again.
issue.no_binding: pi isn't bound to a provider. Bind pi on the Providers tab first.
issue.start_failed: The coordinator couldn't start. Check pi's provider and model, then try again.
issue.orchestrator_exited: The coordinator stopped unexpectedly. Start the workbench again.

folders.label: Folders
folders.empty: Add a folder the agents may work in.
folders.hint: Workers only run inside these folders; the coordinator can only read them.

proposal.title: Proposed tasks
proposal.hint: Pick a folder for each task, then approve it. Nothing runs until you do.

chat.title: Coordinator
chat.empty: Describe what you want done. The coordinator proposes tasks on the board. Run starts each one as its own agent that can change files in its folder, so nothing runs until you press Run (or turn on auto-run).
chat.notRunning: Press Start above to chat with the coordinator.
chat.placeholder: Message the coordinator · type @ to mention a task or session
chat.sendHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.taskMentionDrop: Drop a task tab to reference it (@task)

mention.label: Mention a task or session
mention.hint: ↑↓ to move · Enter to insert · Esc to close

notice.board_full: Some proposed tasks were dropped: the task board is full.

plan.title: Task plan
plan.empty: No tasks in this plan yet. Ask the coordinator for something, or add a task.
plan.pickNode: Pick a task in the plan to see it.
plan.rerunHint: Running it again does not re-run the tasks that depend on it.
plan.runHint: Approve every waiting task in this plan. Each starts once the tasks it waits on are done; the coordinator reviews each one.

taskChat.title: Task chat
taskChat.empty: The initial prompt appears here after you select a task.
taskChat.waitLaunch: Run the task to chat with its agent.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.dragMention: Drag to the coordinator chat to reference this task
tasks.doneNoRelaunch: Completed tasks can't be run again from here. Edit the task or add a new one.
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Ask the coordinator, or add one yourself.
tasks.sessionRequiredHint: Start the workbench from the Coordinator pane to run tasks.
tasks.promptLabel: What to do (sent to the agent)
tasks.isolatedUnavailable: Only a git folder can run a task in its own worktree.
tasks.runAllHint: Run every proposed task that has a folder.
tasks.autoRunHint: Approve the coordinator’s proposals as soon as it makes them, so they start once their folder and dependencies are ready. Applies only to proposals made in reply to your own message.
tasks.notifyHint: When a task needs review, needs input, fails, or is marked done or stopped, tell the coordinator so it can summarize in the chat.
tasks.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Add input validation to the signup form in src/auth, then run the unit tests and fix any failures.
tasks.promptHint: The agent sees only this text, not the chat. Include the goal, the files involved, and how to check the result. Type @ to add a session as background.

errors.INVALID_PARAMS: Some details are missing or invalid.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That task or folder no longer exists.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: That can't be done right now. The workbench may be stopped, too many tasks may be running, or a worktree has uncommitted changes.
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: pi or herdr didn't respond. Try again.
